item.title: Stop trying to nail life or you too could lose it all
item.description: We’re deep in new year’s resolution season and the message is you should try to nail life. But how are we to fit self-improving activities into days already bloated with full-time jobs, dependents and dreary but essential life admin? Veronica Schmidt tried and it ended in calamity. It’s too late, of course, but these days I can see the beauty in being average, in simply making it through each day in a world that demands we be and do so much. item.title: The yellow-legged hornet eradication is on track – but the next few months are crucial
item.description: New Zealand now has a genuine chance to stamp out one of the most damaging invasive insects to reach our shores. But what happens over the next few months might just decide whether the species is eliminated or becomes established.
